|printed_lore=''<span lang="ja">アドヴォーズの男性にはありがちなことだが、ボム・ヴィムディンは同族を嫌っている。ペシミストで縄張り意識が強い。一匹狼の密輸屋で、腐敗した官僚たちが得意先。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
|translation='''Title:''' Advosze.

'''Card text:'''
When you deploy a weapon from hand at the same location as an Advosze, immediately activate 1 Force as a “kickback.” Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. Only one Advosze may be at a location or aboard a starship.

'''Lore:'''
As is common among male Advosze, Bom Vimdin dislikes his own kind. A pessimist with a strong sense of territory. A lone-wolf smuggler whose best customers are corrupt officials.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese kickback is when you deploy a weapon from hand; the English is a weapon or device.
